assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The patient has a diagnosis of recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42).
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9).
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5).
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The payer invited an appeal with supporting clinical documentation.
